evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Creates the main resource (game); complementary capabilities for using, browsing, exporting and deleting games are present in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Invitation flow is supported and complemented by a join-by-URL story (PP-029) and invite-limit (PP-028).

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round uses items which the backlog provides stories to add (PP-006), edit (PP-007), delete (PP-008) and select (PP-005).

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Item listing is backed by add/edit/delete/select item stories (PP-006, PP-007, PP-008, PP-005).

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting items is supported and items can be added/edited/deleted elsewhere in the backlog (PP-006, PP-007, PP-008).

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Addition is complemented by edit/delete/select stories (PP-007, PP-008, PP-005); no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Edit is balanced by add/delete/select stories (PP-006, PP-008, PP-005); creation capability exists.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Delete is complemented by add/edit/select stories (PP-006, PP-007, PP-005), so no missing complementary requirement.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Showing estimates early is supported by the estimate/collect mechanism and related reveal rules; no complementary creation story is missing.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting an agreed value uses existing estimate submission and display stories; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-fill depends on estimate collection and reveal stories (PP-033, PP-034); the necessary estimate submission functionality exists.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Entering the agreed estimate is a standalone action supported by prior stories around collecting and showing estimates; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation is supported via selecting items to re-estimate (PP-005) and browsing prior rounds (PP-039); complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Import capability is self-contained and complements manual add/copy-paste stories (PP-015); no required complementary story is missing.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste is an alternative to import (PP-014) and add (PP-006); required complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is supported by game creation (PP-001) and transcript/export (PP-017..PP-019); the backlog provides the necessary data sources.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Transcripts are supported by stored games (PP-001) and exporting stories/estimates (PP-018, PP-019); necessary storage and retrieval are implied elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting transcripts is complemented by transcript viewing and stored game data (PP-017, PP-001); no required complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export complements transcript/viewing and stored game data (PP-017, PP-001); necessary data storage and retrieval are present in backlog stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Delete complements game creation (PP-001) and browsing/exporting of games (PP-016..PP-019); the complementary creation capability exists.

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is supported and complemented by login, account management and deletion stories (PP-022, PP-023, PP-024).

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is complemented by account creation (PP-021), account management (PP-023) and password reminder (PP-026).

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account edit is paired with account creation and deletion (PP-021, PP-024); the complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion complements account creation (PP-021) and account management (PP-023); complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is a self-contained presentation requirement and does not expose a missing complementary capability elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder is a standalone feature that complements account/login stories (PP-021, PP-022); required complementary account stories exist.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, ...} or {0, 1, ...}
evaluations.rationale: Card set selection is a standalone configuration feature; no missing complementary capability is implied by this story.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Invitation limit complements invite-by-URL (PP-002) and join (PP-029); complementary stories exist to enact invitations.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Join-by-URL complements invite story (PP-002) and invite limits (PP-028); no complementary requirement is missing.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Displaying the current item is supported by item addition/selection stories (PP-006, PP-005); necessary complementary stories exist.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Listing items is backed by add/edit/delete item stories (PP-006..PP-008); complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Estimator identity is supported by join/registration (PP-029, PP-021) so showing who has given estimates has its complementary capabilities present.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Estimate collection and reveal flow is self-contained across multiple stories (PP-034, PP-032); no creation/read/delete complement is missing.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Estimate modification is supported by the estimate submission and reveal mechanics (PP-033); complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Prior-estimate visibility is supported by transcript/scroll-back stories (PP-017, PP-039) which provide storage and navigation of past estimates.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Displaying per-estimator estimates relies on identity provided at join/registration (PP-029) and estimate collection (PP-033); complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer start/visibility is a standalone UI/synchronization feature; no missing complementary capability is evident in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Auto-reset behavior complements the timer start and estimate collection stories (PP-037, PP-033); required capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Scroll-back is supported by stored transcripts and browse features (PP-017, PP-016); storage and export stories exist to back this up.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card-order consistency is an independent UI requirement; it doesn't expose a missing complementary capability elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Estimate change is consistent with submission/reveal stories (PP-033, PP-034); complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: The backlog requires displaying a thumbnail photo but contains no story to create/upload/select a user/avatar photo (no complementary avatar-upload or profile-photo story), so the capability to provide photos is missing.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is a developer non-functional requirement and does not expose a missing complementary functional capability elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Providing definitions is a self-contained developer/documentation requirement; no complementary story is required to implement it.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Creating indexes is an implementation detail for performance; it doesn't expose a missing complementary functional requirement in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser support is a non-functional compatibility requirement; it doesn't reveal a missing complementary functional story.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility is a cross-cutting non-functional requirement and does not indicate any missing complementary functional capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance expectation is non-functional; it doesn't imply a missing complementary feature within the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a platform/internationalization requirement and stands alone; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design is a presentation/UX requirement and doesn't expose a missing complementary functional requirement elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page design is a UI/UX requirement and does not indicate a missing complementary functional capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Data-anonymization requirement is explicit and self-contained; it does not expose a missing complementary capability elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics viewing is an explicit requirement; while it implies data collection, it is itself a standalone feature request and not missing a complementary creation story in the backlog.
